Synthetic heterogeneous drug and protein graph

Source: R/hetero-graph.R
dataset_synthetic_hetero.Rd

A small simulated graph with drug and protein nodes for examples and tests. Proteins belong to latent families; drugs belong to latent classes and preferentially target proteins of the family linked to their class. Drug labels are the latent class, so they can be predicted from the targeted proteins. Protein-protein interactions are denser within families. The data are simulated and carry no biological meaning.

Usage

dataset_synthetic_hetero(
  num_drugs = 60L,
  num_proteins = 80L,
  num_classes = 3L,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

num_drugs, num_proteins

Node counts.

num_classes

Latent classes (drug labels and protein families).

seed

Optional integer seed.

Value

A hetero_graph_data with relations drug__targets__protein and protein__interacts__protein, drug labels and drug masks.
